Latoya wants husband John to be there for her and their kids; John says Latoya won't let go of his past infidelities and disrespects him around the house.
Noesha wants her fiancé, Stephon, to pay as much attention to her as he does to video games; she says Stephon is addicted to video games and plays over 40 hours a week.
Javonna says Darquan's constant lying and cheating drove her away, and she's demanding a divorce.
Ana says Joseph is too busy running the streets and chasing after women to help her take care of the kids; their tumultuous relationship has been plagued by cheating, lies, and gambling issues.
Richard and Amanda have two children together, but he refuses to commit because of her disability.
Shakiya says husband Jacoby didn't tell her he had a child, lied about his military service and gave her a fake ring that turned her finger green; she's now pregnant by another man.

Robert refuses to forgive Iliana for having an affair and questions whether their youngest child is his; Iliana says Robert has been unfaithful too and needs to stop calling her names and trying to control her.
Jay caught Carletha cheating and no longer trusts her; she says he needs to let go of the past and stop being verbally abusive.
Jessica wants Jajuan to move to Los Angeles with her for better career opportunities, but he says relocating will make their bad financial situation even worse.
Tatiana claims Ramsay is a chronic cheater who abandoned her while she was pregnant with his baby; she's now expecting their second child and afraid he'll do it again.
After suffering through financial troubles, a fire and homelessness, Keta is ready to take the children and leave for good; Jairus says Keta just wants to lead the glamorous life with a rich man.
Quaneta claims fiancé Carl is lazy and has a drinking problem, and they haven't had sex in months; Carl says the real problem is Quaneta's attitude.
Jessica has three children with Delvon and is still waiting for a proposal; Delvon says he's holding off on getting engaged until their finances improve and Jessica can have a dream wedding.

Sunnie wants Chris to pay more attention to her and stop treating her career in social media as a joke; Chris owns a restaurant and says Sunnie needs to realize it's his top priority; he's also tired of her taking so many selfies.

A horrible accident left Laronda with a brain injury, and husband Maurice says it's changed her behavior drastically: she has become paranoid and hypersexual, and even wants to bring a third person into their relationship.
Mecca suspects baby daddy D'Andre is cheating on her and says he's immature; he claims she is controlling and has a bad attitude.

Miriam and Eric have been married for two months, and Eric's family members are pushing him to get a divorce -- they say the 18-year-old is too young to be married, and she is just using him to take care of her two children.
Miriam and Eric have been married for two months, and Miriam cheated on Eric just two weeks before the wedding; now she's ready to come clean.

Tiffany and Marcus return to the show, having drifted apart after a miscarriage; he wants children, but she has one and doesn't want any more; money is also a problem: she calls him a cheapskate, and he claims her spending is out of control.
Quintana accuses Tariq of cheating on her, and she calls the cops whenever they fight -- he says this puts his life at risk, and she needs to stop dialing 911.

Beatriz is fed up with Corbett's lies and infidelity; she says he hasn't told the truth since the day they met and doesn't financially support her and their daughter; he says she is verbally abusive, and it's damaging his self-esteem.
Jeffery and Andrea were set to walk down the aisle until she found out he cheated on her with a woman he'd met online; the wedding is now on hold.

Amber claims Kyree is a cheater who has a serious drinking problem and doesn't pay the bills; he admits he's made mistakes in the past but says she is the love of his life, and he wants this relationship to work.
Emory and Ivoiree return due to money troubles, mistrust, and fights over disciplining the children that have torn them apart, and they now [LIVE] as roommates, not as husband and wife.
Dwaka claims Charlie is a habitual stalker who calls her hundreds of times a day and hides in bushes to spy on her; he says it's not stalking because she is his wife.

Ebony is pregnant with her second child with Ryan, but she's ready to leave the relationship: she suspects him of cheating and says his drinking is out of control; he says her temper is the problem, and she needs to stop kicking him out.
Iviera and Leo share a love for motorcycles, but she says he is taking her for a ride by hooking up with multiple women; he admits to cheating and wants her to move past his mistakes.
Anger and jealousy issues have landed Kia and Angel back in Divorce Court: Kia wants a polyamorous marriage but spouse Angel believes three's a crowd.

Kenyona says husband Courtney's affair left her devastated and heartbroken; he feels that, since it happened when they were separated, she should get over it, and she cheated on him by becoming emotionally involved with a man she met online.

Jacques and boyfriend Jelain have a toddler together and another baby on the way, but he says he won't propose because her temper is out of control, and she destroys his belongings; she says he acts single and stays out late with his friends.

The tables have turned in Colby and Kourtney's relationship since they last appeared on the show: back then, she constantly accused him of cheating, then took the judge's advice to work on herself and get a job; now, he says she is the one cheating.

Rachel says Cory asked her to marry him, then took it back, and their relationship hasn't been the same since; he says things went downhill after they moved in together, and he's tired of her bossing him around.

Emily says husband Nathan's infidelity spawned a fatal attraction situation; he says he cheated because she was unfaithful first and got pregnant twice while he was behind bars, and he swears he's no longer fooling around with his former flame.
Denise says her husband, Earl, is a serial cheater and a mama's boy who can't handle money; Earl admits he's done wrong, but says Denise's constant accusations make him stray.

Imani has forgiven baby daddy Marco for giving her an STD, but she can't forget it; he says she won't stop bringing up the past and it's destroying their relationship; he wants more kids and she's worried over the health risks of having another baby.

Dominique and Morris are living apart instead of celebrating their second wedding anniversary; Dominique suspects Morris cheated on her in the beginning of their marriage, and she got revenge by flirting with men on social media.
The painful loss of their baby and bitter fighting have put Drew and Serenity's relationship on hold; he says he wants to marry her, but she won't come clean about cheating on him.
Drew accidentally suffocated his and Serenity's newborn son, and the tragedy was a turning point in their relationship; now that they have another baby, Drew wants to get married and be a family.

Lillian says she found out online that her fiancé, Yahdaiyah, had a baby with another woman; he says Lillian also cheated on him, and he suspects she's still seeing her ex; she is fed up with his bad temper and controlling ways.

Clyde and Wendell are ready to get married, but have been keeping their relationship a secret from Clyde's best friend and roommate Antonio, who just happens to be Wendell's ex; now that they all [LIVE] under the same roof, tensions are running high.

John says wife Melissa got an abortion without discussing it with him, then took off with a married man; she says she cheated because John won't let go of the past; her health problems and his lack of trust have left their sex life in dire straits.
Lonequa fears fiancé Eulis is cheating on her after finding messages he sent to another woman on his phone.
Bryan says he recently went through his husband's phone and found out he was planning a group sex session.
Erika was married when she met Harold, and the pair formed a special bond; when Erika's husband walked out on Christmas Day, Harold moved in.
Jacob gave up the son he had with another woman to save his marriage to Ashley, but it hasn't ended the trouble at home; Ashley claims Jacob cheats and puts down her dreams of being an actress.
After spending time in prison, Curtis is a free man again, but he says his wife, Lolinda, won't let him have a relationship with his family and friends.
Tyesha claims her boyfriend, Charles, is a cheater and an immature mama's boy; Charles says Tyesha is the one behaving badly, and she needs to stop criticizing his close relationship with his mom.
Laurie and Joseph met at an Alcoholics Anonymous meeting 17 years ago; Laurie remains devoted to AA, but Joseph no longer attends meetings and suffered a relapse since they've been married.

Carfricia says Carl's resentment over giving up his rap career to take care of their family fuels his anger and verbal abuse; she also disagrees with his view that Earth is flat and wants him to stop promoting his theories online.
Shanique claims Rasaan is a liar and a cheat who can't be trusted; Rasaan says Shanique has a toxic attitude, and it's poisoning their relationship.

Nathan can't get over wife Kendall cheating on him with a man she met online; Kendall says Nathan's mother is a big source of their problems, and they need to move out of her home and find their own place.
Davetta was diagnosed with HIV a month after she and Jermaine tied the knot, sending her into a deep depression; she says he cheated on her repeatedly and she got revenge by sleeping with other men.

Davetta and Jermaine are dealing with an HIV diagnosis and have two children together; he has admitted to sleeping with nine different women during their eight-year marriage, while she has cheated twice, including with his childhood friend.

Tapeka, who is legally blind, thinks her partner, Stacy, is stealing from her and no longer trusts him; Stacy wants Tapeka to stop the accusations and treat him like her man, not the hired help.

Christina and Bobby fight over money, raising the kids and infidelity; they are behind on rent and can barely pay their bills and, to make matters worse, she says, he destroys their belongings when he gets upset.

Jeffery says Jennifer needs to stop flirting with other men and look for a full-time job to help support their baby; Jennifer says Jeffery's jealousy is hurting their relationship and accuses him of talking to other women.
Greg wants to start a family, but Brittany doesn't want children; he also complains that he's the only one cleaning up after the couple's 15 pets while working multiple jobs.
Best friends Janelle and Cecily dumped their boyfriends and decided to have a same-sex relationship; the BFFs-turned-spouses are struggling to get along just two months after their wedding.

After escaping from prison, the evil Dr. Niemann (Boris Karloff) and his hunchbacked assistant, Daniel (J. Carrol Naish), plot their revenge against those who imprisoned them. For this, they recruit the powerful Wolf Man (Lon Chaney), Frankenstein's monster (Glenn Strange) and even Dracula himself (John Carradine). Niemann pursues those who wrong him, sending each monster out to do his dirty work. But his control on the monsters is weak at best and may prove to be his downfall.
An insane sculptor sends the disfigured criminal he saved from drowning to kill the critics who denounced him.

While on a boating trip, Scott Carey (Grant Williams) is exposed to a radioactive cloud. Nothing seems amiss at first, but several months later Scott realizes that he's shrunk in height by several inches. He sees a doctor, who admits that he's baffled. As Scott continues to shrink, decreasing to three feet tall, he becomes bitter, and lashes out at his wife, Louise (Randy Stuart). He begins to fear a cure will never be found -- since even as he becomes a national sensation, he's still shrinking.

Wrongly accused of murdering his brother, Geoffrey Radcliffe (Vincent Price) is found guilty and sentenced to die. But when sympathetic Dr. Griffin (John Sutton) injects him with a serum that renders him invisible, Radcliffe is able to escape and search for the real culprit. With Inspector Sampson (Cecil Kellaway) of Scotland Yard hot on his trail, Radcliffe begins to suspect that a recent hire in his family's mining company might have the answers he seeks.

In this adaptation of H.G. Wells' novel "The Island of Doctor Moreau," Edward Parker (Richard Arlen) is shipwrecked on a remote island presided over by the mysterious Dr. Moreau (Charles Laughton). Edward discovers his host is conducting genetic experiments, and presiding over a race of half-human, half-animal hybrids, including the alluring Panther Woman and the sage Sayer of the Law (Bela Lugosi). The island has become its own society, with Moreau as its god.

While looking through his telescope one night, John Putnam (Richard Carlson) sees what at first appears to be a meteor shower -- but it is actually a crash-landing alien spaceship! After investigating the crater from the impact, John informs the town sheriff (Charles Drake), and receives nothing but ridicule. Even his fiancée, Ellen (Barbara Rush), is skeptical. All that changes when the townsfolk start disappearing, and are replaced by eerie alien duplicates.
A professor (Clifford Evans) in black rescues stranded 1910 newlyweds from a Bavarian doctor's (Noel Willman) vampire villa.
A fugitive doctor (Lionel Atwill) tries to raise the dead for South Sea Islanders.
A mad scientist (George Zucco) turns his assistant (David Bruce) into a zombie as part of a plan to steal his assistant's lover (Evelyn Ankers).

Ismael lleva a Leonardo a casa de Rutila para esconderlo, pero no es bien recibido, ni por Rutila ni por Mónica. Les pide que lo ayuden a encontrar al Chema; Leonardo quiere conocerlo.
Javi y Aurelio sostienen una conversación que marca el destino de la familia. Ambos coinciden en que Rutila tiene un carácter difícil. Casillas teme que el pasado, les cobre la cuenta.
Mónica se niega a participar en el plan de Tony y Esperanza para acabar con Aurelio. Esperanza sospecha que Mónica podría delatar su plan porque aún ama a Casillas. Rescatan a Salazar.
Leandro cree que si Aurelio sigue siendo el problema, habrá que deshacerse de él. Raymond lo piensa. Esperanza, Tony y Mónica acuerdan competir en el mercado; llaman a Rafael a Colombia.
Esperanza, borracha, se siente culpable por la muerte de Zoe y triste, porque extraña a sus padres. Mónica la exhorta a que no se deprima y que no sea una víctima psicológica de Aurelio.
Todos coinciden en Tenerife. Aurelio, la Madame y Alí, la Marina de España, la DEA y la Interpol. Hay nervios, pero Casillas sabe cómo rescatar las 30 toneladas de droga incautadas.
Aurelio convence a Niñón de que financie la renta de los aviones necesarios en España, para así recuperar el cargamento incautado.
Tony y Mónica hacen negocios con Doble 30 y piensan dejar a Ninón fuera. También planean el secuestro de su hijo. Le dieron instrucciones a Alí para proceder con el ataque.
Ninón le pide a Aurelio que la ayude a encontrar a su hijo, secuestrado por orden de Tony Pastrana. Aurelio la apoya y le promete que lo van a encontrar con vida. El español juega sucio.
Omar disminuye los rumores de que El Señor de los Cielos está vivo. Paloma escapa de la casa presidencial. El primer mandatario le encarga a Casillas una macabra misión contra ella.
Ninón llega al sitio donde tienen secuestrado a su hijo y, momentáneamente, le arruina el operativo de rescate a Aurelio. Casillas le pide a Dalvio que le haga un favor al presidente.
En Marsella, Aurelio toma la iniciativa de atacar a Filemón y a los secuestradores de Leonardo. Alguien resulta herido. Colón y su equipo se enteran de que se están robando la droga decomisada.
Ismael, Raymundo, Chatarrero y sus secuaces recuperan toda la droga. La ubican en las naves robadas y la distribuyen. Dejan muchos muertos a su paso. Ninon revela su secreto a Casillas.
Mónica convence al presidente para que le conceda una audiencia a Pastrana. El español le propone a Terán una vida paradisíaca en el exilio, haciéndose doblemente millonario, pero con una condición.
Ahora que Casillas tocó el corazón de Niñón quiere saber la verdad, si ella mandó a matar a Pilar. Ella insiste en que no lo hizo, pero él no le cree. Rutila se niega a buscar al Chema.
Paloma sufre un paro cardíaco y Omar piensa que murió, pero el médico le informa que la pudieron revivir. Cuando ella reacciona y le pregunta por qué la quiso matar, el presidente desata su ira.
Salvio y sus hombres encuentran a Esperanza, Aurelio ordena que la eliminen. Aunque Salvio no quiere atacar, Skinny dice que deberían hacerlo. Empieza el tiroteo. Hay varias bajas.
Juan Carlos llega a la casa de Aurelio y él se sorprende. Ismael se entera de que el padre de Esperanza logró dar con ellos. Casillas quiere saber cómo lo hizo. Javi anhela un hijo con Rutila.
Juan Carlos le explica a Aurelio cómo llegó hasta él y Casillas trata de saber si le dice la verdad. Salvatierra propone pagar por el rescate de Esperanza. Mientras hablan, secuestran a Pina.
Aurelio hace un recuento de todos los muertos que lleva en su conciencia. Cree que llegó la hora de deshacerse de alguien más. Por su traición, ahora Mónica teme que Casillas le quite a Isidro.
Tras ser descubierta la casa de seguridad, Aurelio ordena evacuarla. Mónica trata de llevarse a Isidro con ella, pero es detenida por Ninón; ambas discuten. Robles es forzada a dejar al niño.
Rutila llama a Casillas y le pide que tenga piedad con Esperanza, porque ella no tuvo la culpa de que la DEA la capturara. Aurelio es tajante y sella su destino. Un video de Terán lo compromete.
Aurelio y sus secuaces observan a Tony y Esperanza. Casillas lleva a Pina y a Juan Carlos para el intercambio por su hija e ignora sus súplicas. Castillo y Colón van al punto de la negociación.
Salvatierra y Salazar llegan en helicóptero a rescatar a Esperanza, pero algo sale mal. Mónica termina su relación con Pastrana y jura acabar con Ninón, con tal de recuperar a su hijo, Isidro.
Javier y Rutila se enteran del plan de los colombianos, de no venderle más coca a los mexicanos y son encerrados por Quezada. Pretenden deshacerse de ellos. Leandro quiere una alianza con Tony.
Aurelio viaja a Colombia para intentar rescatar a Rutila. Tony llega y reconoce a Javi. Por otro lado, se acercan la Felina y Raymundo. La casa de Leandro Quezada está rodeada.
Pastrana está en manos de Aurelio, después que Eunice lo entregara a cambio de Ninón. Como cazador a su presa, Casillas y Skinny lo persiguen. A sangre y fuego, la muerte rodea a todos.

Nadia recibe un video de Víctor despidiéndose de ella y le pide a Alejandro que cuide de su familia. Montserrat le pide a José Luis que le entregue a Romina, pero él se niega y apaga el teléfono para que no pueda localizarlo.
Pedro le pide a Alejandro que mate a Víctor para que le diga dónde está Romina. Víctor le explica a Alejandro por qué salvó a Pedro. Adolfo asesina a Refugio para que no diga que él es el "Alacrán".
Arturo le regala un celular nuevo a Teresa y ella se emociona mucho. Genoveva le exige a Teresa alejarse de Paulo y ella le dice que él es quien la busca.
Mayra le dice a Aída que sabe que planea casarse con Paulo y le pide que considere si él es el hombre de su vida. Arturo defiende a Teresa frente a Genoveva y Aída y les exige respetarla.

Ana Leticia le pide a Santiago que le cuente cómo es Ana Lucía. Santiago le cuenta a Ana Leticia que tiene un tumor en la cabeza. Ramiro le aconseja a Rodrigo que done a la fundación de Ernestina para que no tengan que cerrarla.

Lety y Margarita tienen una terrible pelea en la fiesta de Silvia. Místico le pide a Elena que sea su novia, pero ella lo rechaza. Francisco descubre que Mariana está embarazada y que Lety tuvo relaciones con Joaquín.
El hijo de Braulio confiesa que su verdadero padre es Gabino. Ramona le confiesa al padre Guadalupe que ella es la culpable de la muerte de Augusto.
Columba enfrenta a Camila y grita que Ana Julia no es su hija. Además, el hijo de Gael es secuestrado.

Mariano les cuenta a Ana Leticia y Santiago que logró reabrir el caso de la muerte de Jennifer. Marcelo le dice a Mariano que él le debe la vida y menciona la muerte de Gina. Ana Leticia le pregunta a Mariano si tuvo una relación con Gina.
Isabel les cuenta a Mónica, Elena y Lety que Jorge ya es su novio. Valente despide a Joaquín del instituto por el problema de drogas por el que fue arrestado.
Ramona se siente culpable por la muerte de Augusto. Damián se pone celoso al ver a Elisa consolando a Gael. El padre le dice a Horacio que conoce sus pecados.
Leona consigue regresar a la vida de los Torrenegro. Mientras tanto, un accidente pone de cabeza la vida de todos, ¿quién habrá salido lesionado?

Antes de morir, Refugio intenta decirle a Esmeralda quién es el "Alacrán", pero no lo consigue. José Luis se disculpa sinceramente con Montserrat y le dice que quitará la demanda para quedarse con Romina.
El chisme de que Fernando se peleó llega a oídos del cuartel. Los papás de Fernando le piden a Lety que arregle el regalo de bodas.

Omar urge a Fernando que encuentre la bolsa roja, pues si cae en manos equivocadas, se sabrá todo lo que han ocultado para salvar la empresa: Fernando le dice a Sara que la bolsa tiene muestras para laboratorio.
Fernando confunde a Marcia con Lety por teléfono; Marcia le dice a Fernando que no lo quiere perder, Lety se convence de dejarlo ir.
Alicia cuestiona a las del cuartel y culpa a Juanita de haber tomado la bolsa; Matilde intenta besar a Tomás durante la filmación, pero él le dice que se casará con Leticia.
Luigi se va a Alemania para filmar el comercial de Sport Wing; Fernando le entrega a Lety un dibujo que le hizo; Lety habla por teléfono en clave con Teresita para explicarle su encargo.
Fernando deja su automóvil a media calle para ir tras Lety; las del cuartel se encargan de conseguir lo necesario para filmar el comercial; Raúl y Simón hacen la audición a las modelos.
Se lleva a cabo en Conceptos la audición de las modelos en traje de baño, y Alicia decide que ella quiere ser la modelo del comercial y hará todo para conseguirlo.
Efrén busca a Jazmín y Fernando le pide a Simón que le ayude a encontrarla; Paula María logra que Pilar Zacarías, la modelo a la que quería contratar Luigi, se presente en Conceptos.
El cuartel de las feas trata de complacer los deseos de Pilar para la realización del comercial y Lety le dice que Fernando tiene una doble vida.
Don Erasmo le cuelga a Matilde; Alicia y Pilar chocan sus carritos en el supermercado; Lety le cuenta a Fernando por qué nunca aprendió a cocinar y él acepta que tampoco sabe.
Julieta le aclara a Matilde que es la esposa de don Erasmo, ella se disculpa y sale en busca de Tomás; Fernando le dice a Lety que se siente muy bien con ella y después atiende una llamada de Marcia.
Fernando le cuenta a Omar cómo le fue con Lety; Alicia se queja con Marcia porque Fernando no la deja filmar el comercial y conseguir el dinero que necesita para pagar su deuda.
Pilar se niega a filmar una subida en un caballo, un guardia impide que Alicia entre al club; don Riquelme y su acompañante le enseñan a don Erasmo a jugar golf.
Gerardo le dice a Fernando que habrá problemas con el color del vestuario de las modelos. Ricardo llega a la locación y presenta a Francisco Riquelme como el cliente del comercial.
Fernando, Ricardo y Gerardo siguen el plan dictado por Luigi; el señor Riquelme y su acompañante llegan al bar con don Erasmo; Alicia espía el cámper de Pilar y Tomás la espía a ella.
Don Erasmo regaña a Lety por dejar que la abracen y le pide a Fernando que le ayude a cuidarla, pues al parecer anda en malos pasos y Tomás está en el club.
Pilar le cuenta a su amiga que Fernando aceptó ser Pavel, pero que se dio cuenta de que ya no lo quiere; Lety cuestiona a Fernando y Pilar le dice lo que le confesó.

Lety intenta que su padre entienda la farsa entre Sara y Fernando, por lo que debe decirle la verdad que le ocultó cuando entró a Conceptos; Fernando le cuenta a Julieta cómo se unió el cuartel para que saliera el comercial.
Alicia entra a la oficina de Fernando, pero él la corre porque sabe que solo quiere obtener información; Ricardo le da instrucciones a Fernando para cuando estén en Alemania.
Fernando y Lety se hospedan en un hotel en Alemania; en la agencia de publicidad, Fernando y Lety se enteran de que ya se firmó el contrato con otra empresa.
Marcia escucha las voces de Toño de Valdés y Omar Chaparro y empieza a dudar de Fernando; Lety y Fernando reciben un boleto para el partido de fútbol.
Fernando y Lety se la han pasado de maravilla. Sin embargo, don Humberto le reclama a Lety que no se comunicara con ellos y que no le haya enviado el video que le encargó.
Fernando le dice a Omar lo nerviosa que se puso Lety cuando la encontró en postproducción y él le sugiere ver el DVD de Lety, quien le encarga a Simón mandar un sobre a Londres.
Marcia se enoja con Fernando porque siente que la está engañando. Alicia se queja con Rubén porque las del cuartel se van a un show solo para mujeres y él le recomienda que las acompañe.
Efrén presenta a Jazmín con Cuco y Adrianita, quienes la recuerdan como La Demostradora. A pesar de los problemas con Lola, Efrén le pide que intente mantener una buena relación con los niños.
Alicia logra entrar al show solo para mujeres; Simón, vestido de mujer, es obligado a subir al escenario; los niños destrozan la casa de Efrén y Jazmín lucha con todas sus fuerzas para no enojarse.
Don Erasmo invita a Sánchez y Rosales a tomarse un trago; Lety se desconcierta cuando Fernando no le contesta el teléfono a Marcia; Efrén lleva a los niños a casa de Lola.
Fernando sale a un restaurante con Lety y ella piensa que le da pena que lo vean con ella porque pide una mesa en el lugar más íntimo. Por otro lado, Julieta le pide a la Virgen que proteja a Lety.
Lety se niega a hacer el amor con Fernando y le propone que hasta que los dos sean libres para amarse lo hagan. Fernando decide no terminar con Marcia.
Julian aids a struggling cow in labor on a local farm, contributing to the cycle of life, and hoping to assist in launching a new vet career.
Julian faces a dramatic alpaca farm emergency, racing against time stuck behind tractors to aid a desperate new mother in rural North Yorkshire.
Julian rushes to a local farm where a cow, suffering from milk fever due to calcium deficiency, can't stand; he navigates classic Herriot-style vet work, requiring precision.
Celebrating the relationship between man and dog to mark International Dog Day.
Peter faces a challenge with one-ton bull Pip, who needs an urgent foot trim; the reluctant bull risks flattening Peter.
Amadeus the alpaca has a twig in his eye that has caused a nasty injury; Peter is greeted by a familiar face from Down Under when a slightly depressed baby wallaby arrives at the clinic.
Julian engages in extreme vetting, aiding a struggling ewe's open-field birth in pouring rain.
Julian faces a challenge trying to save one of the biggest calves he's had to deliver; farmer Rob, who lost a newborn two days ago, is fearing the worst.
Jackie Barlow's alpaca farm faces birthing challenges; Julian helps Kestrel, a cria with deformed legs, struggling to walk after arriving.
Peter intervenes on his day off to save Richard Bell's injured lamb at Skeldale; Julian tends to the sick, one-week-old llama, Noah, at Suzanne Benson's trekking center.
Julian performs surgery on his dog, Emmy; Peter removes a tumor from a Great Dane's leg; the team rescue a spaniel injured from a wire fence.
Julian is at Jackie's alpaca farm to see one of his favorite girls, Cinderella; after delivering her baby years ago, he recently performed a C-section when she was struggling.
On Sunday morning, things become urgent for Julian at the Taylors' farm; a sheep with a post-lambing prolapse needs attention, and Julian may get more than just freshly laid eggs as a reward.
A cow with a gruesome leg wound needs immediate care; Julian meets two-year-old Zac and his hedgehog needing foot surgery.
The Greens welcome a new farm member, Magic, a tiny kitten found alone on a main road; Jean and Steve provide a home for the little feline rescued in the middle of the night.
Peter heads to a local farm where Bernie the boar is strangely off his food; Peter fears the problem could be serious, but examining a big boar who's not feeling well isn't easy.
Julian hurries to farmer Joe Holmes, who is puzzled by a cow with hanging afterbirth, suspecting she struggles to give birth; no sign of the calf raises concerns.
Peter faces added pressure treating Charlie, niece Jess' competitive horse; wolf teeth removal is crucial to ensure they won't interfere with the bit during Jess' rides.

Peter rushes to help a cow that is struggling to give birth; father-and-son farmers John and Ian believe the calf is coming backward, but Peter realizes that the job is even more challenging; time is against him if he's going to save the calf.
Julian treats a seriously ill llama called Echo who is having trouble breathing.
Peter tries to save a cow who has suffered a huge prolapse after giving birth; with the newborn calf depending on her mum, the pressure is on.
A sheep faces uncertainty; Peter worries about Flynn, a tawny owl he treated months ago; Flynn's remaining eye issues jeopardize his life.
Julian tackles a dual sheep crisis at the Taylors' farm: a new mom and an expectant ewe both prolapse; Peter handles an emergency surgery for Katie Perry, the superstar collie.
Matt faces a challenging delivery as a laboring ewe from Cannon Hall Farm arrives at the animal hospital; knowing his team, Matt readies for a high-speed car park intervention.
Peter rushes to aid a worried farmer whose calf is unable to stand due to potential joint issues; Julian welcomes Exotic Joe, known for his collection of strange and wonderful creatures.
Peter and Matt address antler problems in Prince the Reindeer at Cannon Hall Farm; at Skeldale, Peter reunites with a cockatiel, Oscar, who once put a vet in the hospital.
Julian must operate on a Bernese Mountain puppy who wolfed down a bizarre feast, including a tea towel; when he visits Rodney's goat kids, Julian must improvise.
Mako, Jackie Barlow's alpaca, has a massive lump on his face and is louder than a football crowd; Julian finds him one of the noisiest patients ever.
Peter heads back to the Teasdales' farm where he recently delivered a healthy calf, but the pressure is on since the expectant mother belongs to Ian's young son, Alfie.

A sheep is rushed into the practice to see Peter after seriously injuring herself on a piece of metal; Peter thinks he can deal with the wound, but the bigger problem is that the ewe is pregnant with twins, and the lambs' lives are in danger.

When his young children are abducted by his old nemesis, Capt. Hook (Dustin Hoffman) middle-aged lawyer Peter Banning (Robin Williams) returns to his magical origins as Peter Pan. Peter must revisit a foggy past in which he abandoned Neverland for family life, leaving Tinkerbell (Julia Roberts) and the Lost Boys to fend for themselves. Given their bitterness toward Peter for growing up -- and their allegiance to their new leader, Rufio -- the old gang may not be happy to see him.
Gon and his friends finally defeat Genthru and collect 99 trading cards.
Gon and Killua head out to meet someone who they hope is Ging; Gon arrives, the man starts yelling at them.
Gon and Killua decide to join Kite and his team in their research mission gathering information on the Chimera Ants.
Kite has narrowed down the location of the Chimera Ants.
Gon and his friends enter the NGL; the Chimera Ants start going through surprising changes.
The Chimera Ants have acquired weapons after attacking Gyro, the shadow leader of the NGL underground.
Gon and his friends come face-to-face with Chimera Ants for the first time.
The Chimera Ants become increasingly vicious after eating the members of the NGL underground.
The Hunter Association sets out to eliminate the Chimera Ants; Gon and his friends become the targets of a squad of Chimera Ants.
Hagya attacks Gon, Killua and Kite; the first of the Queen's Royal Guards is about to be born.
Kite, Gon and Killua continue using Nen to follow Hagya to the Chimera Ant's nest.
Gon and Killua vow to get stronger so they can return and rescue Kite.
Gon and Killua proceed with Biscuit's training.
Gon and Killua are exhausted after their fight with Knuckle.
Knuckle points out to Gon that there are flaws in his ultimate technique, the Ja Jan Ken.
Killua faces Shoot; Gon takes on Knuckle.
The Chimera Ant King is born; the Three Royal Guards, Pitou, Pouf and Youpi, kneel down to respectfully welcome him.
Colt surrenders and seeks the help of the extermination team to help the dying Queen.
The King captures the palace of the Republic of East Gorteau.
Gon is on his date with Palm; Killua encounters Rammot in the forest.
Knuckle and Morel are overwhelmed by the speed of Cheetu's attacks.
Kalluto, Feitan, Shalnark, Phinks, Shizuku and Bonolenov meet in Meteor City; they have returned after getting the news that the Chimera Ant, Zazan, has built her nest in their city.
The members of the Phantom Troupe go to Zazan's nest to defeat her; the Troupe splits up to confront Zazan's minions individually.
Gon and Killua arrive in a village in East Gorteau but find no trace of the inhabitants.
A pair of Chimera Ants appears and hunts Gon under the cover of night; feeling that things are at a standstill, he gathers his Nen and prepares to throw a punch.
Knuckle and Shoot are lying in wait for Cheetu; as Cheetu is about to approach them, he suddenly changes direction and disappears; Killua and Gon sense that someone is following them again.
The assassin Ikalgoan octopus-type Chimera Ant, attacks Killua with his Nen Abilities.
Gon tries to bond with Meleoron, even though it's risky for a Nen user to reveal his abilities.
The King is killing time as he awaits the selection.
Knov is making his way to the palace.
The King is annoyed and confounded after meeting Komugi, the unfathomable Gungi world champion; he proposes a wager with Komugi; if Komugi wins, he'll give her whatever she wants.

Morel has been chased into an underground church by the lion-type Chimera Ant, Leol; Leol activates his Nen Abilities and produces a giant wave and a surfboard; Morel then reveals that those are his friend's abilities.
Gon, Killua, Kurapika and Leorio reunite to face a dangerous opponent who was once a member of the Phantom Troupe.
Gon and Killua have gained new allies and prepare to charge into battle.
The King realizes that Shaiapouf is hiding something.
Palm decides to tell the King where Komugi is.
The battle between humans and the Chimera Ants ends.
The executive council of the Hunter Association are summoned to discuss the election of a new chairman.
An election is held to determine Chairman Netero's successor.
A closely guarded Zoldyck family secret is revealed.
Killua defies his family's wishes in order to revive Gon.
The fourth round of voting to select the new chairman is held.
Hisoka appears before Gotoh and the other butlers who are trying to protect Killua.
The remaining eight candidates now compete in the fifth round of voting to select the new chairman.
The seventh round of voting is held, and the field narrows to the remaining four candidates.
Beans counts the votes and the winner is revealed.
Gon recovers and sees his father, Ging, for the first time.
Koala confesses all of his sins to a red-haired girl.
Gon and Ging spend their first father and son moment together.
After facing discrimination and death, shadow hunters make a move to eliminate the light hunters.
Stroheim returns from the brink as a cyborg designed to secure the great Red Stone; Kars is not willing to concede and wages war, even as the stone hurtles toward an alpine cliff.
Lisa Lisa paints a picture of honor when she reveals Caesar's tragic past to Joseph; in the face of certain danger, Caesar enters into a solitary battle to avenge his father.
Inside a shadowy St. Moritz hotel, danger leaves Joseph and Lisa Lisa no time to mourn as they follow a bloody trail to Wamuu and Kars; Lisa Lisa manages to strike a deal -- with one condition.
Joseph and Wamuu finally face off in an equestrian one-on-one; Joseph's adroit attacks and weapon-grasping prowess may not be enough to keep Wamuu's millennia-old pride in check.
When the battle between Wamuu and Joseph comes to a head, the surprising confessions aren't far behind.

With Lisa Lisa's life on the line, Joseph must deceive the deceiver; joining Joseph, Stroheim and Speedwagon arrive at the battlefield, where a family tragedy threatens to doom the world to a hopeless future.
Having seized the Red Stone and the mask, Kars has become the Ultimate Being; now the seemingly invincible entity has his sights solely on Joseph who has one final trick up his sleeve.
Deep within a volcano's molten lava, Kars contemplates a comeback, but with the Red Stone's power unleashed, both warriors are launched into the stratosphere of the unknown.
A young man who is a descendant of the Joestar clan, Jotaro Kujo, refuses to leave a jail cell because he believes he is possessed by an evil spirit.
Jotaro finds out that the evil spirit he has is actually called a Stand, and tries to hide its existence as he tries to live a normal life.
With his evolved Stand powers, Jotaro defeats Kakyoin, an assassin sent by DIO.
Jotaro and crew head to Egypt, where they think DIO is hiding, and run into another one of DIO's assassins on the plane.

Jotaro and his comrades are attacked by Polnareff, an assassin with a Stand called Silver Chariot that is capable of lightning-fast swordplay. It falls to Avdol to face down the threat using Magician's Red.
On a boat journey to Singapore, a stowaway is found and causes a commotion and then Jotaro is targeted by an enemy Stand from within the water.
The group manages to escape the boat that was destroyed by the fake captain and drift on an emergency boat.
Jotaro and crew arrive in Singapore and once they get to their hotel, they separate; Polnareff finds Soul Sacrifice waiting for him in his room.
Joseph uses Hermit Purple to create a message using the TV, which tells them that Kakyoin is a traitor.
Jotaro and the others safely leave Singapore and enter India; Polnareff gets attacked by a mysterious Stand that is inside a mirror.
While trying to save Polnareff, Avdol gets struck down by the enemy's attack.
Jotaro and the others next head toward Varanasi; Joseph realizes his arm is quite swollen.
Polnareff drives a car on a very dangerous mountain road toward Pakistan, and recklessly passes a slow moving vehicle that was in front of him.
Jotaro and the others successfully survive another attack from the enemy Stand users and make it into Pakistan.

Polnareff finally realizes that Enyaba is another assassin from DIO and tries to warn the others, but Enyaba's Stand, Justice, has the ability to take control of people's bodies and corpses, and he gets pursued.
After surviving Enyaba's attack, Jotaro and crew make it to Pakistan's capital, Karachi, where they encounter DIO's next assassin, Dan of Steel.
Dan of Steel's Stand, The Lovers, enters Joseph's brain; Dan tells Jotaro to do various things for him, knowing Jotaro has no choice but to obey.
Jotaro and the others suspect someone is following them through the desert on their way to Cairo.
Kakyoin dreams about being in a strange amusement park, where he encounters the Death tarot card.
Kakyoin tries to convince everyone that he's not crazy by showing them that his arm has "Baby Strand" carved into it.
Jotaro and the others visit an island on the Red Sea and meet Avdol's father.
Polnareff gets attacked by his sister after he revives her using one of the wishes he received.
Jotaro and the others obtain a submarine to travel through the Red Sea as they head toward Egypt where DIO awaits.
Jotaro and the others try to escape as the submarine begins sinking from an attack from the enemy Stand, High Priestess.
Jotaro and the others arrive in Egypt, and are joined by a Boston terrier named Iggy.
Avdol sets a trap for N'Doul, but it doesn't work.
Kakyoin and Avdol are badly hurt in the battle with N'doul, and are taken to a hospital in Aswan.
Jojo and the others look for a boat to take to Cairo where DIO awaits; Chaka walks along a nearby beach where he finds a sword that glows.
Polnareff defeats Chaka the Anubis Stand user, but the barber he visits suddenly starts talking about Anubis and attacks him.
Jotaro and the others arrive in Luxor; Joseph sees an electrical outlet in a rock and gets shocked when he investigates.
Due to the powers of an enemy Stand, Joseph's body becomes magnetized.
Jotaro gets concerned that Joseph and Avdol haven't shown up yet, and goes to look for them.
Because of the power of Alessi's Stand, Set, Polnareff is turned back into a child.
After a long journey, Jotaro and the others finally reach Cairo and start looking for DIO's mansion.
After losing to D'Arby, Joseph and Polnareff have their souls taken.
Hol Horse arrives at Cairo in order to pursue Jotaro and the others, and joins forces with Mondatta.
Hol Horse and Mondatta follow Jotaro and the others to Cairo.
Following Avdol's advice, JoJo has a beggar look for DIO's mansion.
Iggy ends up in a battle to the death against the falcon that guards DIO's mansion.
Jojo and company finally make it to DIO's mansion, where they meet the butler named D'Arby Younger.
The battle for souls with D'Arby continues as Kakyoin challenges D'Arby to a race game.
The baseball match with D'Arby continues, but Jotaro starts declaring his pitches to D'Arby.
Polnareff can't control his emotions when, after a long journey, they must say goodbye to a friend.
Polnareff is pushed to his limits with Cool Ice's merciless attacks.
Polnareff finally comes face to face with DIO, who offers to allow Polnareff to join him again.
A nighttime battle against DIO takes place in the city of Cairo.

Soldier zombies in Washington, D.C.; Ten Thousand's mysterious past is revealed.
The survivors search for Warren's missing husband in Central Illinois; a zombie tornado threatens the group.
A utopian enclave may not be all it seems near Branson, Mo.; the group's encounter with a religious cult may cause drastic changes.
Still reeling from the events, the survivors come across a gun show that makes the zombie apocalypse look tame.
In Nebraska, a zombie tsunami engulfs the survivors and desperate measures must be taken to survive; Citizen Z gets a visitor.
When Mack tries to have a real date with Addy, he finds himself in a nightmare that reminds him of a certain Bill Murray film with déjà vu vibes.
Radioactive zombies aren't the only danger when the survivors visit a town in South Dakota on the brink of nuclear disaster.
An all-female commune in Utah is where the two groups of survivors reunite, but when someone winds up dead, the illusion of paradise is shattered.
Murphy learns more about his abilities when he is kidnapped by a group of outlaws trying to score OxyContin; drug enhanced zombies attack.
Citizen Z redeploys the survivors to meet with Murphy's doctor; but at the compound they uncover game-changing details about their mission and the origins of the zombie virus.
Heroes battle zombies and overeager bounty hunters; Murphy manages to escape; Vasquez considers working with the group.

The team finds an abandoned Air Force base and discovers what looks like alien technology.

Veteran police detective Roger Murtaugh (Danny Glover) is only days away from retiring when he and his tough partner, Martin Riggs (Mel Gibson), are roped into an important internal affairs case. Working with the beautiful, no-nonsense Sergeant Lorna Cole (Rene Russo) and aided by the shifty informant Leo Getz (Joe Pesci), Murtaugh and Riggs begin to close in on a black-market weapons operation involving corrupt cop and arms dealer Jack Travis (Stuart Wilson).

Detective Riggs (Mel Gibson) tries to settle down with his pregnant girlfriend, Lorna (Rene Russo), while his partner, Murtaugh (Danny Glover), comes to grips with the marriage of his pregnant daughter, Rianne (Traci Wolfe), to fellow cop Butters (Chris Rock). But they find themselves and their families targeted by Chinese mobsters, led by Wah Sing Ku (Jet Li). Riggs, Murtaugh, Butters and private eye Getz (Joe Pesci) decide to go on the offensive before the gangsters get to their loved ones.

After his partner and family are killed, FBI agent Jack Crawford (Jason Statham) becomes obsessed with revenge on an assassin named Rogue (Jet Li). Rogue's return sparks a violent war between rival Asian mobsters Chang (John Lone) and Shiro (Ryo Ishibashi), while the ultimate showdown between Crawford and Rogue reveals the truth.

Landing in jail for a petty theft crime, Alvin finds himself sharing a cell with John Jaster, the incarcerated half of the pair of high-tech thieves responsible for the missing gold. His partner, Bristol, is still at large. Alvin wants only to get out of prison and start fresh with his girlfriend, Lisa, and when the Feds, led by U.S. Treasury investigator Clenteen, set him loose on a sketchy deal, he thinks his luck has changed. Alvin has his freedom and the Feds have found their bait.

When Joseph Verrett (Andre Braugher), a Jesuit priest who teaches history at a black high school, is offered the position of basketball coach, he resists at first because he believes the school glorifies sports over education. Eventually, though, Joseph accepts and sets up a game with the unbeaten team from the white Jesuit high school. Father Grant (Rip Torn), the pastor of the parish, cautions against such a divisive move, but Joseph disagrees and prepares his team for the game.

In 1956, Frankie Lymon and the Teenagers landed a doo-wop hit with Why Do Fools Fall in Love? Fame turned to tragedy as lead singer Lymon (Larenz Tate) descended into substance abuse that eventually claimed his life at age 25. But Lymon didn't just leave his fans bereft -- he also left behind three women, and each believes she's owed his song royalties: Platters singer Zola Taylor (Halle Berry), prostitute Elizabeth Waters (Vivica A. Fox) and schoolteacher Emira Eagle (Lela Rochon).

Poet and professor Melvin B. Tolson teaches at the predominantly black Wiley College in 1935 Texas. He decides to start a debate team, something nearly unheard of at a black college. While at first he butts heads with the influential father of one of his best debaters, eventually he is able to form a team of strong-minded, intelligent young students, and they become the first black debate team to challenge Harvard's prestigious debate champions.

Clyde Shelton is an honorable family man, until the day his wife and daughter are murdered in a home invasion. He hopes for justice, but a rising prosecutor named Nick Rice cuts a deal with one of the killers in exchange for testimony. Ten years later, that man is found dead.

Police drama about a veteran officer who escorts a rookie on his first day with the LAPD's tough inner-city narcotics unit. "Training Day" is a blistering action drama that asks the audience to decide what is necessary, what is heroic and what crosses the line in the harrowing gray zone of fighting urban crime. Does law-abiding law enforcement come at the expense of justice and public safety? If so, do we demand safe streets at any cost?

Delivery man Leo Jackson (Donald Faison) is definitely on the wrong road to success. He still lives at home, he and his girlfriend just broke up, and he has multiple complaints stacked against him at work. Fortunately, Leo has plenty of marijuana to keep his mind off his troubles. But when he accidentally delivers a box of cocaine to the wrong address, Leo finds himself in the middle of a bad deal that may just cost him his life.
Movie, Comedy drama, Crime drama, Action
An Elvis impersonator, meth-addicted white supremacists, and a man searching for his wife hunt for a missing wedding ring.

Gary Faulkner (Nicolas Cage), an ex-con, unemployed handyman, and modern day Don Quixote receives a vision from God telling him to capture Osama bin Laden. Armed with only a single sword purchased from a home-shopping network, Gary travels to Pakistan to complete his mission. While on his quest, Gary encounters old friends back home in Colorado, new friends he makes in Pakistan, the enemies he makes at the CIA -- and even God and Osama themselves.
Movie, Comedy, Crime drama, Biography, Action, Thriller

In New York City in 1987, a handsome, young urban professional, Patrick Bateman (Christian Bale), lives a second life as a gruesome serial killer by night. The cast is filled by the detective (Willem Dafoe), the fiancé (Reese Witherspoon), the mistress (Samantha Mathis), the coworker (Jared Leto), and the secretary (Chloë Sevigny). This is a biting, wry comedy examining the elements that make a man a monster.
Two corrupt cops, who make money blackmailing criminals, come up against one who may be far more dangerous than both of them.

A group of old college friends reunite for a Juneteenth weekend getaway, only to find themselves trapped in a remote cabin with a twisted killer. Forced to play by his rules, they soon realize this isn't a game.

When flight attendant Jackie Brown (Pam Grier) is busted smuggling money for her arms dealer boss, Ordell Robbie (Samuel L. Jackson), agent Ray Nicolette (Michael Keaton) and detective Mark Dargus (Michael Bowen) want her help to bring down Robbie. Facing jail time for her silence or death for her cooperation, Brown decides instead to double-cross both parties and make off with the smuggled money. Meanwhile, she enlists the help of bondsman Max Cherry (Robert Forster), a man who loves her.

A former assassin, known simply as The Bride (Uma Thurman), wakes from a coma four years after her jealous ex-lover Bill (David Carradine) attempts to murder her on her wedding day. Fueled by an insatiable desire for revenge, she vows to get even with every person who contributed to the loss of her unborn child, her entire wedding party, and four years of her life. After devising a hit list, The Bride sets off on her quest, enduring unspeakable injury and unscrupulous enemies.

The Bride (Uma Thurman) picks up where she left off in volume one with her quest to finish the hit list she has composed of all the people who have wronged her, including ex-boyfriend Bill (David Carradine), who tried to have her killed four years ago during her wedding to another man. Leaving several dead in her wake, she eventually tracks down Bill in Mexico. Using skills she has learned during her assassin career, she attempts to finish what she set out to do in the first place.

It is the first year of Germany's occupation of France. Allied officer Lt. Aldo Raine assembles a team of Jewish soldiers to commit violent acts of retribution against the Nazis, including the taking of their scalps. He and his men join forces with Bridget von Hammersmark, a German actress and undercover agent, to bring down the leaders of the Third Reich. Their fates converge with theater owner Shosanna Dreyfus, who seeks to avenge the Nazis' execution of her family.

Two years before the Civil War, Django (Jamie Foxx), a slave, finds himself accompanying an unorthodox German bounty hunter named Dr. King Schultz (Christoph Waltz) on a mission to capture the vicious Brittle brothers. Their mission successful, Schultz frees Django, and together they hunt the South's most-wanted criminals. Their travels take them to the infamous plantation of shady Calvin Candie (Leonardo DiCaprio), where Django's long-lost wife (Kerry Washington) is still a slave.
Frost releases a serial-assault suspect, then two children are murdered, and their mother is reported missing.
While investigating a woman's death, Frost is led to believe that the husband was responsible, until a priest reveals a man's confession to him.
A woman's body is found on a train at the same time a female surgeon is reported missing; someone makes indecent assaults while impersonating Frost.
Either the Task Force or her sister's boyfriend may have kidnapped a hard-working woman; meanwhile, Frost's house burns down.
Frost suspects that a young soldier killed on maneuvers was murdered.
Frost goes into the sex industry to probe a series of murders.
Frost investigates the death of a young physiotherapist, which leads him to a religious author and pillar of the New Union Church.
Frost investigates the armed robbery and later, murder of a pawnbroker and begins to suspect one of the victim's children of the crime.
Frost (David Jason) becomes involved with an investigation into the death of a reclusive art collector. With Bruce Alexander and Caroline Harker.
Frost investigates the death of a homeless teenager found beaten and drowned in the Denton River. With David Jason, Cyril Nri and John Lyons.
An old adversary of Frost's (David Jason) becomes a suspect in an attempted armed robbery of a brewery. With Philip Jackson, Paul Brightwell and Peter Egan.

In Atlanta, when a young father is found dead in his home by his girlfriend, detectives track down the killer and find things are not as they appear; a Tulsa, Okla., teenager is fatally shot, sending police on a desperate search for the motive.
In Tulsa, Oklahoma, a young man stands up for his girlfriend and pays the ultimate price; a man is gunned down in front of his girlfriend after someone from her past goes over the edge.
A young college student's life takes a tragic turn after he falls under the influence of a mysterious friend.
Mobile, Ala., detectives investigate the murder of a young mother of two and unravel the deadly plot that took her life.
In Tulsa, Okla., a homeless woman and her boyfriend are taken in by a friend; when he ends up dead, they have to choose between saving themselves and doing the right thing.
A teenager is shot dead in Tulsa, Okla., and detectives must uncover the truth among his roommates' stories; in Mobile, Ala., a young man's murder sets off a retaliatory shooting.
When a shy mechanic is found shot dead outside a notorious apartment complex far from home, Detective Max Ryden needs to discover what brought him there.
Tulsa detectives investigate the Neighborhood Crips to solve the murder of a young man trying to leave the gang.

To embarrass his rival, a scheming senator (Lawrence Dane) uses nitwit Ohio teens who are invited to a Washington gathering on educational failure.

Willy Beachum (Ryan Gosling), a hotshot prosecutor, is about to leave his post for a lucrative job at a private law firm when his boss (David Strathairn) hands him a seemingly open-and-shut case. Ted Crawford (Anthony Hopkins) tried to kill his wife with a shot to the head and is defending himself in court. All hope for a quick and easy trial flies out the door when Ted proves to be a more cunning and devious adversary than Willy anticipates.

When Cleveland Heep (Paul Giamatti) rescues an enigmatic young woman (Bryce Dallas Howard) from danger, little does he know that she is a character from a bedtime story, who is trying to return to her world. As he falls deeply in love with her, he begins to realize that he and fellow tenants are also characters in the fable, and they must work together to protect her from those who would prevent her from returning home.

Celebrated author and efficiency expert Frank Allen (Ryan Reynolds) has always lived in step with a well-planned series of lists and timetables. His wife (Emily Mortimer) decides to play a joke on him and sets his clock back 10 minutes, but the consequences are far greater than expected. As Frank's well-ordered existence unravels, he opens up to the randomness of life.

In this film based on actual events, black activist Medgar Evers is murdered in 1963, and much of the evidence points toward white supremacist Byron De La Beckwith. However, after two trials, De La Beckwith is acquitted twice by a jury of whites. Now, decades later in 1989, Evers' widow, Myrlie, thinks she has evidence to finally convict him. But no lawyer will touch the case except the young and brash Bobby DeLaughter.

An arms dealer eager to score a big contract, Eddie Muntz (Chevy Chase) heads to South America to negotiate with both a dictator and the revolutionaries who oppose him. Although talks don't go well, and he gets wounded, Muntz remains determined to sell his unmanned planes. Joined by Catherine DeVoto (Sigourney Weaver), the widow of a colleague, and Ray Kasternak (Gregory Hines), a pilot rethinking his views on violence, Muntz launches a go-for-broke attempt to make his arms deal.

Gardner Barnes is a young Texan who has just graduated from college and is unsure of what to do next. Along with his friends, collectively known as the Groovers, Gardner embarks on a road trip to the Rio Grande as a last hurrah for the group. As the trip progresses, Gardner and his buddies, including Kenneth Waggener and Phil Hicks, struggle with their impending adulthood and the looming issue of the Vietnam War.

Dr. Will Caster (Johnny Depp), the world's foremost authority on artificial intelligence, is conducting highly controversial experiments to create a sentient machine. When extremists try to kill the doctor, they inadvertently become the catalyst for him to succeed. Will's wife, Evelyn (Rebecca Hall), and best friend, Max (Paul Bettany), can only watch as his thirst for knowledge evolves to an omnipresent quest for power, and his loved ones soon realize that it may be impossible to stop him.

Looking for a way out of their mundane government jobs, Austin Millbarge (Dan Aykroyd) and Emmett Fitz-Hume (Chevy Chase) take the entrance exam for a CIA espionage program. Immediately chosen to take part in a top-secret mission in the Middle East by the officious Gen. Sline (Steve Forrest), the new recruits are set upon by Soviet forces in Afghanistan. Soon it becomes clear that the hapless pair are being used as decoys to expose the Russians for a Cold War nuclear showdown.

Teenager Reagan Wills dreams of playing soccer like Alex Morgan, her hero. A poster of the soccer star magically comes to life in Reagan's bedroom, and Alex helps Reagan learn the value of determination.

When a British TV show becomes popular, an American network often makes its own version of the show. In this case, Lifetime is importing this series that pits four amateur cooks against one another as they compete for a cash prize. Each contestant prepares a meal for a dinner party -- with a unique theme, location and menu -- for the other competitors, who critique and score the cook. The contestant who earns the most points for his or her party wins the title of the host with the most and, more importantly, the money. Radio personality Todd Pettengill narrates the series.

Detective Kiera Cameron is a cop from the year 2077 who was raised to rely on technology more than anything else, even herself. Now she and a group of deadly criminals called Liber8 are trapped in present-day Vancouver. Cameron needs to stop Liber8 before it can take down the corporations which will one day rule the world -- thus altering the course of the future and changing the 2077 that Cameron calls home. She enlists the help of a teenage tech genius named Alec Sadler to help figure out a way to get her back to her own time, and she manages to work with the Vancouver Police Department with Detective Carlos Fonnegra to keep an eye on Liber8. With different ideals and backgrounds, Cameron and Fonnegra clash, but they trust each other, and Cameron is slowly learning to trust herself as well.
Kiera races to track down what she thinks is another time traveler while fending against interference from factions of Liber8 and a determined Agent Gardiner.
Sam's birthday causes Kiera to have an emotional breakdown which activates a psychiatric program embedded in her CMR.

Un hombre intenta saltar de un auto en movimiento durante una persecución de alta velocidad. Un hombre se mete en problemas cuando intenta ganar dinero fácil. Un oficial investiga a un hombre al que reconoce caminando en una calle oscura.

Un hombre se rehúsa a dar su nombre real, pero los oficiales lo descubren. Por otro lado, un conductor tímido tiene problemas para ser directo.

Un sospechoso entra en pánico cuando los agentes descubren sus planes. Una mujer comete una violación de tránsito mientras va al salón de belleza. Una relación intensa termina en golpes.

La policía trabaja en una situación de alto riesgo y la convierte en una enseñanza. Un sospechoso intenta estafar a dos agentes de policía. La falta de pericia de una conductora para realizar cálculos simples la mete en un problema.
Los agentes protagonizan un enfrentamiento con un hombre en busca y captura. La policía investiga a dos hermanos sospechosos. Una disputa entre vecinos se agrava cuando uno de ellos busca venganza.

Un pasajero hablador mantiene a todos en alerta durante un operativo de tráfico de rutina. Los agentes buscan a un ladrón de tiendas que se dedica exclusivamente a hurtar productos de bebés. Un novio angustiado no puede más con su relación volátil.

Los oficiales se sorprenden al encontrar a un niño en el asiento trasero de un automóvil involucrado en un accidente. Por otro lado, una denuncia por hurto conduce a la policía a una mujer enloquecida y varios artículos desagradables. Además, un hombre llama a los oficiales porque su hijastro se comporta de manera extraña.

Un ciclista cuenta una versión diferente de los eventos que provocaron su arresto. Los agentes acuden a un disturbio que involucra a un hombre agresivo y a una salsa de barbacoa. Una persecución termina en la casa de la novia del conductor.

Los oficiales reaccionan rápidamente cuando un pasajero ocasiona problemas durante un control de tráfico. Una familia tiene un final feliz cuando un representante recupera a un cachorro robado.
Una pelea frenética entre hermanos termina con una puñalada. Los oficiales de la policía arrestan a un hombre que está delirando después de que ataca a su hermano y a su vecino.

El pasajero de un vehículo que se dio a la fuga logra escapar, pero el conductor no tiene tanta suerte. Un motociclista que huye se salva de milagro de impactar contra un automóvil, pero el destino le depara otro infortunio.

Surgen problemas cuando oficiales realizan una inspección policial de vehículos. Un tío paranoico ataca a su sobrino adolescente cuando buscaba algunas cosas perdidas. Una mujer en libertad condicional se asusta cuando descubre lo que hay en su auto.

Una historia de amor que nace en medio de la avaricia de una familia, los destinos de Paulina y Rafael se cruzan y ellos caen víctimas de un amor profundo, el cual, está condenado al infortunio porque ellos provienen de dos clases sociales totalmente distintas, ella proviene de una prominente familia que posee uno de los consorcios hoteleros más grandes del país y por el contrario, él es un hombre humilde que no tiene nada que ofrecer a nivel monetario. Su amor puro y verdadero, deberá enfrentar a la familia de Paulina que está en contra y que desea que ella se case con un hombre afluente. Su destino es luchar por su amor y defender su felicidad por "Quererte Así".

Cada capítulo de una hora relata historias reales y dramáticas, en donde sus protagonistas exponen sus casos conmovedores que llegan a tocar los corazones del público, incluyendo al de la conductora del programa y gracias a la ayuda de un equipo experto de profesionales y de la audiencia que está presente en el estudio, se tratan de resolver estos conflictos personales o familiares que los invitados están enfrentado.

While Tom drives the Land Rover Defender to an Icelandic glacier, Blur's Alex James bungee jumps from a crane. Meanwhile, a Ford GT and a Formula Ford go head-to-head.
Tim Lovejoy takes golfer Ian Poulter to the track to try out the Ford GT, Jason Plato drives the Type 25 Subaru Impreza, and Tom Ford goes on a very rural school run in the new Land Rover Freelander.
Jason puts two sporty convertibles through their paces, Tim looks at car maintenance, and Jonny hits the road in the `Ghostbusters' ambulance.
Tom discovers ways to beat the wheel clampers and John Travolta reveals his passion for cars. Meanwhile, the cast of 'Hollyoaks' take on a series of boy versus girl challenges.
Vicki Butler-Henderson takes the new Fiat Panda 100HP for a spin around the track - against a Ferrari, and Tiff Needell hits Las Vegas to try out Audi's first supercar, the R8.
Vicki finds out if an old Daihatsu Charade is the toughest car you can buy, and Tim learns to park in an impossibly small gap.

Iwan Thomas accepts a stunt challenge from world-famous precision driver Russ Swift. Observing supercars trying to beat the 0-62 world record. Jonny Smith secretly repairs the potholes that local councils refuse to. Tom Ford drives a Monster.

Tiff Needell and Jason Plato pit a BMW Z4 against an Audi TT, Vicki Butler-Henderson sees how tough a Daihatsu Charade can be, and Tiff tries out a three-wheeled car. Meanwhile, Jonny Smith goes to Germany to watch the new Corsa being put through its paces.

The late, great Ayrton Senna's nephew Bruno joins the programme as a new guest presenter. Meanwhile, Tim Shaw finds out which dealers are responsible for the biggest rip-offs regarding servicing costs.

Tom heads to an auction of 🏎️ [F1] Formula One CEO Bernie Ecclestone's car collection. Elsewhere, Vicki pits the Lotus Exige S against the Caterham CSR at Anglesey.

The fastest car in the world, the 890,000-pound Bugatti Veyron, is subjected to its first ever television test, Johnny Smith tests a potential revolution in city transport, the Mitsubishi 'i', and Tom Ford tests the new Maserati GranTurismo coupe.

Tom Ford has 24 hours to get to Valencia in the BMW M5 Touring Car, Jason Plato test drives the sexiest car of the moment, the Aston Martin V8 Vantage Roadster, and Jonny Smith takes a spin in the new Ford Mondeo, as used by James Bond in 'Casino Royale'.
Featuring a death-defying loop-the-loop stunt, a race against David Coulthard, and a test to see if buying an old banger can beat the credit crunch.

Jonny Smith finds out what happens when children ride unrestrained in the back of taxis, Jason Plato drives an exotic Italian supercar, the Maserati Gran Turismo, and there's a gruelling 24-hour off-road driving event: the Exeter Trial.
While Jonny tests whether some of the cheapest cars can make it to the top of Britain's steepest road, Vicki finds out whether a police driver or a racing driver is the faster.
Tim Shaw is the latest car nut to join the team, and he's been specially tasked with standing up for the beleaguered motorist. Jason Plato and Tiff Needell go head-to-head on the track.
They won gold in Beijing, but how will the three blondes in a boat handle a Ferrari and Jason Plato? Then, get a stomach-churning taste of the fastest motorsport on Earth.

Tiff Needell and Jason Plato race two V8 mega-saloons. Tom Ford has the only television test of the charismatic Dodge Challenger. Vicki Butler-Henderson finds out which car is quickest between the Vauxhall Astra Nürburgring and Ford Focus ST.

Jason Plato gives England cricket hero Kevin Pietersen a racing masterclass while Tom Ford finds out whether the all-new Mini 2 is better than the current model. Plus, what's the ultimate Bond film car chase? Vicki Butler-Henderson reviews the candidates and asks the public to vote.
Vicki tests the limits on Bentley's fastest ever production car, the Continental GT Speed, Jonny searches for a bargain price coupe and Tiff takes a spin in a 🏁 [NASCAR] NASCAR race car.

Vicki chauffeurs comedian Bill Bailey around town in a very unusual Mercedes, Tom Ford test-drives the funky new Kia Soul, Jonny presents his pick of the best budget cabriolets, and Tim Shaw reveals how the crumbling economy equals big savings on new vehicles. Also, this week, there is a classic Fifth Gear shootout, and Tiff takes the new Lamborghini Gallardo LP560-4 for a spin.

Olympic swimmer Mark Foster tries out a Vauxhall VXR8, Jonny Smith watches vintage cars being trashed at a banger race, Tim Shaw re-takes his driving test, Vicki Butler-Henderson tests the new Smart city car, Jason Plato compares two handy Renaults and Tiff Needell casts his eye over the new Porsche 911.
Jason drives the impressive 500bhp Ford Shelby GT500, and Tiff races Mitsubishi's Evo 9 FQ360 against a former Red Arrow pilot's stunt plane.
Tom Ford test drives stunning Aussie supercar the Vauxhall Monaro and Vicki Butler-Henderson fulfils a lifetime ambition by driving a racing truck.
Tiff and the team test the most exciting cars on the road. Vicki risks life and limb to drive a car under a moving lorry and actor Chris Barrie fulfils his driving dream.
Jonny finds a novel way of testing out the Renault Mégane.
Jason goes off-roading with rugby ace Phil Vickery and Tiff puts the new Lexus IS F through its paces on the track. Tom takes the new Volvo XC70 to extremes in the Arctic Circle.

Jason Plato practises some extreme piloting skills with the Blue Eagle army helicopter regiment, Vicki Butler-Henderson puts the brand new Honda Jazz through its paces, and actor Dirk Benedict, best known as Face from 'The A-Team', joins Jonny Smith to road test the Mercedes S-Class. Plus, Tim Shaw finds out if it is possible for motorists to save money by servicing their cars themselves.
A Land Rover Defender 90 versus a Suzuki Jimny, and in the shoot-out: Volkswagen Up GTI versus a Suzuki Swift Sport.
Vicki heads to Italy to drive a new convertible version of the Ferrari 458, Tiff conducts a shootout between two ultra-powerful coupes, and the team test the most economical car on the planet.

In this tenth-anniversary special, the presenters look back at some of their most memorable moments. Jonny attempts the Isle of Man TT circuit on a three-wheeled scooter, and Tiff and Vicki test two of the most exciting cars on the market - the BMW M3 GTS and the Porsche 911 GT3 RS.
Vicky heads to Italy to road test the new Ferrari F12 Berlinetta, while Tiff and Jason trial the Suzuki Swift and Renault Sport Twingo.
The team head to Warsaw, where Tiff gets behind the wheel for the final stage of the Barborka Rally. Vicki test drives three extraordinary cars from Poland's past.
Vicki races the new BMW M5 round the Pau Circuit in France, and the team test the Mercedes-Benz G-Wagen. Plus, can the Renault Megane hot hatch outperform the Nissan 370Z?
Ken Hasegawa vs. Ryuta Sakurai; Keita Nakamura vs. Yoshiyuki Katahira. From Feb. 28, 2015 in Tokyo.
